subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Utilizar, ao produzir um texto, conhecimentos linguísticos e gramaticais, tais como ortografia, regras básicas de concordância nominal e verbal, pontuação (ponto final, ponto de exclamação, ponto de interrogação, vírgulas em enumerações) e pontuação do discurso direto, quando for o caso.

components.description_pt: Aplicar convenções padrão de escrita ao compor textos escritos
components.description_en: Apply standard English conventions when composing written texts
components.cc_component_description: Apply standard English conventions when composing written texts

components.description_pt: Usar concordância correta entre nome e verbo em sentenças escritas e faladas
components.description_en: Use correct noun and verb agreement in written and spoken sentences
components.cc_component_description: Use correct noun and verb agreement in written and spoken sentences

components.description_pt: Aplicar convenções corretas de pontuação, incluindo vírgulas, apóstrofos e pontos finais
components.description_en: Apply correct punctuation conventions including commas, apostrophes, and end marks in writing
components.cc_component_description: Apply correct punctuation conventions including commas, apostrophes, and end marks in writing

components.description_pt: Usar aspas para indicar discurso direto ou citação de um texto
components.description_en: Use quotation marks to indicate direct speech or a quotation from a text
components.cc_component_description: Use quotation marks to indicate direct speech or a quotation from a text

cc_matches.description: Use knowledge of language and its conventions when writing, speaking, reading, or listening.
Use commas and quotation marks to mark direct speech and quotations from a text.
Demonstrate command of the conventions of standard English grammar and usage when writing or speaking.
Demonstrate command of the conventions of standard English capitalization, punctuation, and spelling when writing.
